result.text:
If you're looking for the best accounting + tax service in Denver, I'd shortlist these based on current local ratings, services, and how well they fit different needs:
🏆 My top picks


Wiggs CPA Tax and Accounting — Best for small businesses


5.0★ with 164 reviews


Business taxes, bookkeeping, payroll, and year-round tax planning


Particularly geared toward small businesses and self-employed professionals.


My pick if you want one firm to handle both accounting and taxes.




EMC Accounting Group — Best for virtual/full-service accounting


5.0★ with 89 reviews


Tax planning, bookkeeping, tax resolution, and QuickBooks support


Strong option if you prefer doing most things remotely.




Abacus Accounting Center, LLC - CPA Firm — Best established full-service option


4.9★ with 54 reviews


Tax preparation/planning, bookkeeping, payroll, outsourced accounting, and business advisory


Particularly suitable for small-to-midsize businesses and professional practices.




Blue Bear Tax Solutions — Best for complicated tax problems


4.8★ with 221 reviews


Tax preparation, planning, IRS issues, audits, appeals, and tax resolution


Worth considering if you have back taxes, IRS notices, or a complicated return.




EPIC TAXES — Best highly rated Denver tax-focused option


5.0★ with 325 reviews


Personal and business taxes, bookkeeping, and sales-tax support.




If you're a business owner
I'd narrow it to Wiggs CPA, EMC Accounting Group, or Abacus. For a business, I would prioritize a firm that does year-round tax planning + bookkeeping/accounting, rather than one that only prepares your tax return.
